basic_info.description: Classic Italianate architecture meets refined contemporary design at 163 Octavia. This beautifully updated top-floor 2BR/1BA condo in the heart of Hayes Valley puts the best of San Francisco at your doorstep. Hardwood floors and soaring ceilings welcome you into the central hallway. A geometric accent wall frames the bright living and dining areas, flowing naturally to the kitchen - for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen features quartz countertops, marble tile backsplash, stainless-steel appliances, and a spacious pantry cabinet with pull-out organizers. These social spaces open to a tranquil private-use patio. Each of the two bedrooms offers distinct charms: one features a skylight with a remote-controlled blackout shade, while the other boasts a stone-clad fireplace and built-in shelving. A large office space with peekaboo City Hall views, an elegant bathroom with custom tilework, and in-unit laundry complete the home. The garage includes a private storage room and easy-access parking space. Rated a "Walker's + Rider's Paradise" and "Very Bikeable" by WalkScore.com, 163 Octavia is steps from Hayes Valley's boutiques and cafes, plus the cultural gems of Civic Center - a true urban haven.
